policy.finalRule: Canonical framework CSS must not contain vw/vh/vmin/vmax.
policy.protected: Responsive breakpoint contracts and JS overlay geometry behavior must be preserved.
policy.note: Viewport closeout complete. Fixed roots use percentage geometry, floating surfaces use their portal/container containing block, preview media inherit fixed preview-root constraints, and NoticeService projects its JS-owned viewport measurement as a CSS pixel variable so zero-width slot geometry is preserved.
